This rebalance: (1) keeps Offense/Mobilization/Production/Mobile at 90-100 to prioritize aggressive unit production and deployment to the Indonesian front; (2) sharply reduces naval flavors from ~95 to 50-70 — we have enough navy for transport; (3) drops Nuke/UseNuke from 90 to 10 since we lack the era/tech; (4) raises Ranged from 30 to 70 for siege support against Indonesian cities; (5) raises Espionage from 30 to 60 to leverage our 4 spies already in Indonesia; (6) trims Gold from 100 to 70 and Science from 90 to 80 to give military flavors more relative weight. The goal: force the tactical AI to redirect Rome's idle army toward conquering Indonesian cities before their tourism overwhelms us.

Poland is a natural strategic partner: they share our war against Denmark, have open borders with us, and their 8 World Congress delegates complement our bloc. Currently at 0/0 despite mutual friendship signals (trade partners, shared embassies, fought common foe). Setting Public 60/Private 60 solidifies this into a reliable alliance. Poland also borders Denmark and is at war with them — a stronger bond could coordinate pressure on Denmark's coal-rich territory, indirectly solving our coal problem.

The England war is a phony war: 0% war score, 0% war weariness on both sides. England even holds a +20 public opinion of us and we share Hinduism. This stagnant front ties up attention and units. Setting moderately positive values signals we're open to peace, which would free up military resources for the critical Indonesian campaign. The private value (40) is slightly higher to encourage the AI to initiate reconciliation without making us look weak.

At MinorCivWarBias 10, our tactical AI is likely wasting units attacking city-states (several are at war with us) instead of focusing on Indonesia. Rome's UA gives +30% combat strength vs city-states and yields from conquered ones, so some aggression is good — but right now Indonesia's cultural victory is the existential threat. Reducing to 7 maintains the Rome UA advantage while reducing the AI's distraction from the main front.

Keep Combustion queued after Dynamite. Even without coal (Denmark holds all 20, and we're at war), the Arsenal building boosts city strength — useful defensively. More importantly, if we can secure coal through peace with Denmark, conquest, or a new source, landships become immediately available. Landships are the unit that could decisively break Indonesian city defenses before their cultural victory locks in. The alternative (Scientific Theory for Public Schools) is a longer-term science play when we need immediate military results.

Keep Exploitation (Imperialism branch) as next policy. It grants +2 Food/+1 Production from Farms, Camps, and Plantations, and +1 Production/Science from coasts — directly boosting our military production capacity and food for sustained war. We're 6 turns from adoption and this synergizes perfectly with the Production:100 and Mobilization:100 flavors. Finishing Imperialism also strengthens our conquest-oriented policy tree.
